own_consolidation.new_written_candidate_delta: Using a single rank-two2+2matching test, prove a copositive block matrix with rank-one negative cross block. Two scalar simplex minima give a controlled PSD coherent part; two explicit positive partial-transpose pair blocks complete W=P+Q^Gamma for every two-block-positive diagonal-Bell coefficient matrix, including zero boundaries. This is a witness-class no-go against unrestricted tested PPT states, not a theorem covering every two-block-positive witness.
